Image 2 is only the approved chunky matte outline style. Rebuild the source motif as a compact clear 32-by-32-pixel HUD symbol with broad forms.

Warm-gray armor with muted dark slate-blue shadow planes, cyan visor and opaque bright cyan square fragments. Each cyan square has a simple dark-blue outline and at most one pale flat highlight. All cyan is bounded by actual shapes; absolutely no external glow, mist or bloom. Reduce small armor seams, fine bolts, granular pixel spray and tiny circuitry; no scratches, grain or realistic shine. Native 32-pixel readability is paramount.

True transparent background with every outer row and column at alpha zero; no opaque backdrop, checkerboard painting, ground shadow, haze, halo or stray pixels. No words, numbers, logos or watermark. Must composite unchanged on white, black and olive.
